title: 2014 Ford Focus Dent Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed dent repair on a black 2014 Ford Focus so the owner could add it to their Turo rental fleet.
story: A customer purchased this black 2014 Ford Focus from a Craigslist seller to add to their Turo rental fleet. Before listing the vehicle for rent, the owner brought it to Carcis Autobody Repair to fix body dents and surface damage quickly.

Dent repair on door panels requires carefully reshaping the metal back to its original contour. Technicians work across the panel to smooth out distortions without compromising structural integrity. Once the body lines are aligned, the panel surface is prepped and refinished to restore a clean appearance.

After completing the bodywork, the panels were inspected to confirm smooth reflections along the side profile. The Ford Focus was returned to the customer, ready to go into service for their rental fleet.
